name: Eyaris
note: Extreme but real geography after Earth, on continents shaped by plate collisions. The Dematrus Mountains are one solid massif the width of the Alps and the height of the Himalaya where two plates meet; Stones Hold is built into its north flank. Around the first continents lies the rest of the planet: more continents, ice lands at both ends and island chains, none as large as the main continent.
